title: SmartCraft
description: A smarter, more visual recipe viewer — left click any item to see how to craft it, right click to see all its usages
body:
**SmartCraft Beta 1.0.0** is a client-side mod designed to make crafting and item usage easier to explore in Minecraft.

**Features:**  
- View any item’s crafting recipes (Crafting Table, Furnace, Smoking, Blasting, Stonecutter).  
- Explore how any item is used in other recipes.  
- Smooth navigation with “◀” and “▶” buttons to switch between multiple recipes or usages.  
- Detailed information display: cook time, XP gained, recipe type, item names.  
- Hover over items to see tooltips.  
- Modern, clean GUI with color highlights for easy readability.  
- Fully compatible with Minecraft Fabric.
